status.details: The frozen jmax-dom contract exposes build::parse(Payload, Limits) -> jmax_dom::Document, while jsonmax::Document is the distinct ABI ValidatedDocument alias. No safe conversion or proof-publication API is specified for this direction. The facade must not issue ValidationProof with unsafe code, and returning the DOM type violates the frozen public signature. The parse_payload implementation currently calls the available DOM builder; it requires a safe lower-layer conversion API before it can satisfy the frozen return type. No cargo, rustc, rustfmt, or build/check command was run.
